title: antennaria parvifolia f. brunnea
intro: Antennaria parvifolia f. brunnea, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria parvifolia f. brunnea include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing redness and swelling, and its antimicrobial properties, which can help combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
